import/no-default-export.reason: Convex codegen fails unless convex.config.ts has a default export.

import/no-named-export.reason: Convex names each function after its export, so a default export renames events.list.

oxc/no-async-await.reason: A mutation must await what it reads, and the then and plain Promise forms fail other rules.

vitest/no-importing-vitest-globals.reason: An alias such as it as check hides each test from require-hook and expect-expect.
